title: Negative threshold characterization
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on sign vectors of length $n$, and let $a\in\mathbb{R}^n$. Suppose that for every sign vector $x$, $f(x)$ is the sign determined by the threshold at the linear form $\sum_{i=1}^n a_i x_i$. Then $f(x)=-1$ if and only if $\sum_{i=1}^n a_i x_i<0$, for every $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on sign vectors of length $n$
$f$ agrees everywhere with the threshold sign of the indicated linear form
$x$ is any sign vector of length $n$
